bot.name: UAlbertaBot
bot.description: A Terran MarineRush opponent with a fixed opening and no learning between games.

externalRatings.notes: User-supplied saved standings; exact rated build and server measurement date unknown. Not a rating for this pinned source build.

formats.notes: Terran local 1v1 tested on Fighting Spirit with x86 and x64 SC:R; human and observer sessions. See the release review for exact builds and limitations.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Strategy learning is inactive in the pinned source. The packaged fixed configuration disables opponent result storage and opponent-specific overrides; in-game chat cannot change these settings.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Package includes patched corresponding source and verified rebuild/relink instructions, with UAlbertaBot/BOSS/SparCraft/StarDraft MIT, RapidJSON MIT, msinttypes/smallsha1 BSD, BWAPI LGPL/GPL, and ShieldBattery MIT notices.

localDistribution.evidence: Scoped staging package source/notice and rebuild review: https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/ualbertabot-sb-3/docs/ualbertabot-source-review.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Track separately from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Partial BWAPI semantics; legacy unit limits required.
Only the fixed Terran 1v1 profile is verified; other formats and human skill are uncalibrated.
Fresh bot process and isolated working directory per match.
One observer launch stalled before gameplay; retries succeeded. See review for details.

sourceReview.evidence: Scoped staging review, including source side effects, fixed configuration, package rebuild, live sync, lifecycle and socket/file inventories; not a sandbox certification. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/ualbertabot-sb-3/docs/ualbertabot-source-review.md
